title: Inventory datasets index, capsules, claim analysis, mutation, property, and vacuity assets

authority.status: reusable ISI, semantic-state/capsule contracts, IR claim/property declarations, controlled mutation fixtures, and narrow tactician vacuity checks present; no AAE mutation campaign or general vacuity analyzer

planning_baseline.plan_claim: Datasets provides IncrementalSemanticIndex, repository-state/delta and invalidation models, dependency graphs, SemanticCapsuleCompiler@1 through the functional capsule compiler, capsule freshness and raw-source fallback, test/proof selection, canonical bytes, and CID authority.

workspace_collect_only.note: Collect-only enumeration is evidence of test assets; it is not a green acceptance run and is not re-labeled as AAE campaign readiness.

owns_for_aae_reuse: storage-neutral semantic-state producer (bundle, root, Merkle, capsules)
AnalysisConfidence exact/conservative/heuristic/opaque taxonomy and durable AnalysisLimitation records
IR claim/assumption/obligation declarations and software-verification property vocabulary
controlled semantic-state mutation fixtures and ISI invalidation fixtures
canonical content identity (CIDv1 profile) under logic.software_contracts.content
narrow heuristic vacuity/non-vacuity checks inside ProofCandidateValidator@1
does_not_own: accelerate MutationLedger@1 file-lineage ledger (accelerate analysis package)
AAE domain package adversarial_assurance (planned; not present as a public package on this pin)
integrated semantic mutation campaign, equivalent-mutant analyzer, expected-detection engine
general formal/policy/test/ZK vacuity families (analyze_vacuity and related AAE APIs)

conflict_policy.rule: Inventory only. Do not invent missing APIs, second scanners/graphs/compilers/CID profiles, or a public SemanticCapsuleCompiler class. Missing AAE surfaces are typed_unavailable.
conflict_policy.semantic_capsule_compiler: SemanticCapsuleCompiler@1 is an interface identifier implemented by the functional capsule compiler in semantic_state/capsules.py; it is not a public class and must not be re-created.
conflict_policy.identity: Canonical bytes and CID authority only from logic.software_contracts.content.
conflict_policy.mutation_ledger: MutationLedger@1 is accelerate lineage evidence, not a datasets mutation-campaign engine and not an AAE assurance campaign.
conflict_policy.vacuity: Only the located narrow heuristic is_vacuous_statement/_check_non_vacuity path may be cited as existing formal-vacuity support; do not label it as analyze_vacuity or four-family vacuity analysis.

ir_claims.role: solver-neutral claim / assumption / proof-obligation declarations with no verification verdict

proof_candidate_validation.role: ProofCandidateValidator@1 including narrow heuristic non-vacuity stage

duplicate_helper.note: is_vacuous_statement also appears in abduction.py; candidate_validation.py owns the validation pipeline stage _check_non_vacuity

semantic_governor.role: SCG coverage/policy contracts reusing AnalysisConfidenceRank; not an AAE campaign engine

values.meaning: Analysis fact is exact under declared extractor/scope assumptions; may support exact capsule substitution when also fresh.
Sound over-approximation or conservative admission; may support conservative_substitute_with_caveats when fresh with visible caveats.
Heuristic observation only; never raises confidence; raw source required for capsule admission; cannot discharge proof obligations.
Opaque/unresolved analysis; raw source required; may force full test/proof fallback; always visible in limitations.

analysis_confidence.promotion_rule: Confidence is never raised by combining evidence; least-confident rank wins where ranks are combined.

admission_coupling.conservative_substitute_with_caveats: fresh + conservative with at least one visible caveat

analysis_confidence.explain_boundary: explain_symbol / explain_impact report recorded graph facts and confidence limitations only; they do not promote lexical, heuristic, or opaque observations into runtime-behavior claims.

index.name: IncrementalSemanticIndex

construction.signature: IncrementalSemanticIndex(*, scanner: RepositoryScanner | None = None, store: SemanticIndexStore | None = None)
construction.side_effects: none on construct or import; no store inferred from path; no watch started

methods.name: scan_repository
methods.signature: (self, repo_path: str | os.PathLike[str], previous_state: RepositoryState | None = None) -> RepositoryState

methods.name: calculate_invalidation
methods.signature: (self, previous_state: RepositoryState, current_state: RepositoryState, delta: RepositoryStateDelta) -> InvalidationPlan

methods.name: watch_repository
methods.signature: (self, repo_path: str | os.PathLike[str], callback: Callable[[WatchNotification], object], *, debounce_ms: int = 250) -> RepositoryWatch
methods.notes: Only API that may create a worker thread; notification-only

methods.name: publish_state
methods.signature: (self, state: RepositoryState, *, expected_old_cid: str | None = None) -> str

determinism: Cold and incremental scans of identical repository bytes produce byte-identical RepositoryState and state_cid
previous_state is verified reuse only; never changes cold identity
reuse diagnostics live outside durable root identity

semantic_state_extension.extend_semantic_invalidation: preserves ISI obligations and adds environment-binding obligations; default max 2000
semantic_state_extension.select_tests_and_proofs: pure selection; never imports or collects target tests
semantic_state_extension.compare_test_selection_oracle: pure metrics; accelerate supplies run facts

capsules.owner_statement: semantic_state/capsules.py is the sole owner of SemanticCapsuleCompiler@1

functions.name: compile_semantic_capsule
functions.signature: (semantic_index: RepositoryState | SemanticIndexForCapsules, stable_symbol_id: str, *, relevant_bindings=None, binding_set=None, environment_bindings=None, relevant_projection=None, projections=None) -> SemanticCapsule
behavior: Compiles one deterministic authoritative capsule from sealed ISI view plus bindings-owned relevant projection
Never rediscovers binding scope as a second authority
Never references another capsule or symbol-node CID as a dependency (cycle-free content identity)
Heuristic metadata keys (llm_summary, summary, ai_summary, generated_summary, ...) excluded from authoritative truth
Promoted metadata keys only: defaults, contracts, effects, exception_behavior, docstring, docstring_hint

functions.name: compile_semantic_capsules
functions.signature: (semantic_index, *, relevant_bindings=None, binding_set=None, environment_bindings=None, projections=None, previous_bundle=None) -> CapsuleCompileResult
behavior: Batch compile; previous_bundle accelerates only after complete current inputs reverify and stored block bytes are byte-identical to cold path
Cold and verified-incremental compilation over identical inputs are byte-identical

supporting.read_required_source: producer-bound raw source materialization; never treats heuristic/capsule text as exact source

claim_analysis.description: Existing claim-analysis assets are (1) AnalysisConfidence-ranked semantic graph facts and explanations, and (2) solver-neutral IR claim/property declarations. They do not constitute AAE claim/specification analysis or assurance-gap diagnosis.

explain_api.boundary: Does not turn lexical/heuristic/opaque observations into runtime-behavior claims; opaque paths always include raw-source requirements.

constraints: obligation assumption_ids must reference declared assumptions
digest is declaration identity independent of any verification run

Assumption.note: Declaring an assumption does not establish that it is true

ProofObligation.note: Theorem-shaped target with no implied verification status

not_present: assurance-gap taxonomy as a datasets API
expected-detection claim binding as a datasets API

mutation.description: Existing mutation assets are fixture corpora and invalidation cases for selection/index soundness. There is no integrated semantic mutation campaign engine in datasets.

public_fixture_helpers: materialize helpers for baseline + single case

mutation.plan_mapping_note: Plan body/signature/schema/exception/fixture/config/plugin/lock/policy/generated/dynamic/native/deletion/rename mutation cases map to the controlled fixture required kinds and ISI fixture set above.
